title: PocketAgents: A Manifest-Driven Library of Autonomous Defense Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.21694v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Connecting large language models (LLMs) to defensive enforcement requires more than asking a model whether an attack is happening. A defender must decide which model outputs may change the system state, which outputs must be rejected, and how failures should be recorded. We present PocketAgents, a manifest-driven library of autonomous defense agents. Each agent is installed as three data files: a manifest, a prompt, and a runtime context. The shared runtime gives the agent bounded telemetry access and accepts only typed reports whose requested action appears in the manifest. We implemented PocketAgents on top of Perry, a cyber-deception testbed, and evaluated two agents for the Command and Control and Exfiltration tactics in 18 closed-loop trials of a DarkSide-inspired attack on a small enterprise topology. Thirteen trials produced validated network-block actions and contained the attack; four failed schema validation; one prod

translated_title: PocketAgents：一个清单驱动的自主防御代理库
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）接入防御执行体系，不仅仅是询问模型是否正在发生攻击。防御者必须决定哪些模型输出可以改变系统状态，哪些输出必须被拒绝，以及如何记录失败情况。我们提出了PocketAgents，一个清单驱动的自主防御代理库。每个代理以三个数据文件的形式安装：一个清单、一个提示词和一个运行时上下文。共享运行时为代理提供有界的遥测数据访问权限，并且只接受其请求的操作出现在清单中的类型化报告。我们在Perry（一个网络欺骗测试平台）之上实现了PocketAgents，并针对命令与控制（C2）和数据渗出战术评估了两个代理，在小型企业网络拓扑上对模仿DarkSide的攻击进行了18次闭环试验。其中13次试验产生了经过验证的网络阻断动作并遏制了攻击；4次未能通过模式验证；1次……
tldr: PocketAgents是一个清单驱动的自主网络防御代理库，每个代理仅需清单、提示词和运行时上下文三个数据文件即可安装，共享运行时对其遥测访问权限和可执行动作进行严格约束，在18次DarkSide风格攻击的闭环试验中13次成功产生经验证的网络阻断动作并遏制了攻击。
en_tdlr: PocketAgents is a manifest-driven library of autonomous defense agents, where each agent is installed as three data files (manifest, prompt, and runtime context) with strictly bounded telemetry access and manifest-checked typed actions, and in 18 closed-loop trials of a DarkSide-inspired attack, 13 produced validated network-block actions that contained the attack.
